title: Mapped Motor
text: 以转矩控制模式运行的映射电机和驱动电子设备，输入 4 路、输出 4 路；按 {Parameterize losses by} 指定电气损耗的参数化方法 Single efficiency；{Port configuration} 指定端口配置 Torque、{Import Torque Limits Calibration} 指定直接导入转矩限制校准表的方法 selection、{Calibrate Maps} 使用实测数据校准损耗表的方法 selection、{Import Loss Calibration} 指定直接导入损耗校准表的方法 selection、{Import Efficiency Calibration} 指定直接导入效率校准表的方法 selection、{Parameterized by} 指定转矩包络的参数化方法 Tabulated torque-speed、{Speed breakpoints for maximum torque, w_t} 指定转速、{Maximum torque values, T_t} 指定转矩、{Maximum torque, torque_max} 指定转矩、{Maximum power, power_max} 指定功率、{Torque control time constant, Tc} 指定时间常数、{Maximum torque as a function of speed and voltage, Tmax_w_V} 指定转矩、{Speed breakpoints for maximum torque, w_Tmax_bp} 指定转速、{Voltage breakpoints for maximum torque, V_Tmax_bp} 指定电压、{Minimum torque as a function of speed and voltage, Tmin_w_V} 指定转矩、{Speed breakpoints for minimum torque, w_Tmin_bp} 指定转速、{Voltage breakpoints for minimum torque, V_Tmin_bp} 指定电压、{Motor and drive overall efficiency, eff} 指定电机和电机驱动器的组合效率 η 0，在效率设定点处测量、{Speed at which efficiency is measured, w_eff} 指定速度、{Torque at which efficiency is measured, T_eff} 指定转矩、{Iron losses, Piron} 指定功率、{Fixed losses independent of torque and speed, Pbase} 指定功率、{Speed breakpoints for losses, w_eff_bp} 指定断点、{Torque breakpoints for losses, T_eff_bp} 指定断点、{Temperature breakpoints for losses, Temp_eff_bp} 指定断点、{Voltage breakpoints for losses, V_eff_bp} 指定断点、{Loss table, losses_table} 指定二维查找表 M -by、{Loss table, losses_table_3d} 指定 3-D 查找表 M -by- N -by- L、{Loss table, losses_table_4d} 指定 4-D 查找表 N -by- M -by- K -by- L、{Efficiency table, efficiency_table} 指定二维查找表 M -by、{Efficiency table, efficiency_table_3d} 指定 3-D 查找表 M -by- N -by- L、{Efficiency table, efficiency_table_4d} 指定 4-D 查找表 N -by- M -by- K -by- L、{Rotor inertia, J} 指定惯性 5e-6、{Rotor damping, b} 指定阻尼 1e-5、{Initial rotor speed, omega_o} 指定速度，按实例取值。
